landing.metaDescription: Evelyn does the shopping, cooks in your kitchen in Bergamo and leaves labelled portions in your fridge for several days. Groceries at receipt cost. Get an instant quote.

hero.title: Dinner is already done. All week long.
hero.lead: Evelyn does the shopping, cooks in your kitchen and leaves ready portions in your fridge, each labelled with the dish and the date. You get home and just heat it up.
hero.note: Instant estimate, no commitment. We reply on WhatsApp.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Four steps, from your first message to a full fridge.
how.step1Text: Tell us how many people, for how many days, which meals and any allergies. You see an estimated price straight away.
how.step2Text: Evelyn messages you on WhatsApp, suggests a menu and agrees the day and time with you.
how.step3Title: Shopping and cooking at your place
how.step3Text: On the agreed day she buys fresh ingredients and cooks in your kitchen. Meanwhile you can work, go out or just enjoy the smell.
how.step4Text: Meals are already split into portions, each with the dish name and the date it was made. Just heat and eat.

included.title: What's included
included.item1Text: Home-style recipes, varied and seasonal, chosen around the tastes of whoever sits at your table.
included.item2Text: Evelyn buys everything she needs before arriving. Nothing for you to think about.
included.item3Text: {minRecipes} to {maxRecipes} recipes per session, made on the spot with fresh ingredients.
included.item4Text: Every portion shows dish and date, so you always know what's in the fridge and what to eat first.
included.item5Text: Recipes take into account the allergies, intolerances and diets you tell us about.

pricing.title: How you pay
pricing.intro: Two separate items, always clear. No subscription, no hidden costs.
pricing.serviceText: This is Evelyn's work: shopping, travel and time in the kitchen. You see it straight away in the calculator and we confirm it in the quote before you decide.
pricing.groceriesText: You pay what the ingredients really cost, as on the supermarket receipt, with no mark-up. You always get to see the receipt.
pricing.methodsText: Cash, bank transfer, Satispay or a card payment link: you choose when you confirm.
pricing.exampleText: 2 adults and 2 children, dinner for 5 days: 20 portions.
pricing.exampleNote: About {exTime} of cooking. Actual groceries are whatever the receipt says.

who.title: Who it's for
who.familiesText: For parents who work all day and still want real, home-cooked food on the table.
who.prosText: For anyone who gets home late, has no time to shop and is tired of living on delivery.
who.kidsText: Simple, wholesome dishes, with portions sized for them and a lighter grocery bill.

allergies.title: Allergies and diets, handled with care
allergies.text1: In your request you can flag the 14 main allergens listed in EU Regulation 1169/2011 and vegetarian or vegan diets. Evelyn chooses recipes accordingly and checks the label of every ingredient.
allergies.text2: With coeliac disease we take extra care, especially about cross-contamination: utensils and surfaces, certified gluten-free ingredients, the order things are prepared in. Cooking happens in your kitchen, so for severe allergies it's best to talk first.
allergies.text3: Allergies and diets are health data: we only ask for them with your explicit consent, and use them only to cook for you.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Bergamo and the surrounding area. Put your area in the request and we'll tell you straight away if we can get there.
faq.q2: How long does a session take?
faq.a2: It depends on how many portions and recipes: usually a few hours. The calculator gives you an estimate of the cooking time; Evelyn does the shopping before she arrives.
faq.q3: How long do the dishes keep?
faq.a3: Usually 3–4 days in the fridge, depending on the recipe. For later in the week some dishes can be frozen: Evelyn will tell you which. Every portion shows the date it was made.
faq.a4: Simple, varied home cooking: pasta, mains, vegetables, soups. You decide the menu together before each session, based on tastes and season.
faq.a5: No. The calculator gives an estimate; Evelyn sends you the actual quote on WhatsApp and you only confirm if you're happy with it.
faq.q6: What if I need to cancel?
faq.a6: We'll give you the cancellation terms together with the quote, before you confirm.

final.title: Free evenings, full fridge.
final.text: Work out your quote in a minute. No commitment: Evelyn replies on WhatsApp.

privacy.metaDescription: How we process the personal data collected through the quote request form (Art. 13 GDPR).
privacy.draftNotice: To be reviewed by an adviser before using it with real clients. The parts in square brackets still need to be filled in.
privacy.bindingNotice: Courtesy translation: the Italian version is the binding text.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how we process the personal data you give us through the quote request form on this website, as required by Art. 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the “GDPR”).
privacy.controllerBody:
The controller is Evelyn [surname], [tax code / VAT number], Bergamo.

Contact: email [email] or WhatsApp, on the same number that receives the requests.
privacy.dataBody:
• Contact details: name, phone, email (optional), area or neighbourhood.
  • Request details: type of service, number of adults and children, days, meals, preferred day and time of day, notes.
  • Allergies, intolerances and diets (including coeliac disease and vegetarian or vegan diets): only if you tell us, and only with your explicit consent (section 5).

We don't ask for diagnoses or medical records: we only need to know what to avoid in the kitchen.
privacy.purposeBody:
• To prepare and send you the quote and the suggested menu.
  • To organise and carry out the service: shopping, cooking, labelled portions.
  • To communicate with you about anything related to the request and the service.
  • To meet tax and accounting obligations, if the service takes place.

We don't use your data for advertising and we don't sell it to anyone.
privacy.legalBody:
• Contact and request details: pre-contractual steps and performance of the contract, at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
  • Allergies, intolerances and diets: your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).
  • Tax records: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacy.healthBody:
Allergies, intolerances and coeliac disease are health data, and some dietary choices can also reveal personal beliefs. That's why we ask for them with a separate, explicit consent, which you can refuse: in that case we can neither receive them nor take them into account in the menu.

Only Evelyn sees them, and she uses them only to cook for you. You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to the contact in section 1; withdrawal does not make earlier processing unlawful.
privacy.flowTitle: 6. How the data reaches us (trial phase)
privacy.flowBody:
During this phase the website does not store form data on any server: the quote is calculated in your browser. When you press “Send”, WhatsApp opens with a pre-written message, which you send yourself.

The message travels via WhatsApp, a service of WhatsApp Ireland Limited (Meta group), with end-to-end encryption, and reaches Evelyn's phone. WhatsApp's own privacy policy also applies to your use of WhatsApp; Meta may process some data (for example usage metadata) outside the European Union too, with the safeguards required by the GDPR.
privacy.recipientsBody:
• The website's hosting provider, [provider name], which only processes technical browsing data (such as the IP address in logs) to run and protect the site.
  • If you pay by card or Satispay, the payment data is processed directly by the payment provider.
  • The accountant (commercialista), for tax documents, if the service takes place.
  • The authorities, only when required by law.

Health data is not shared with anyone.
privacy.retentionBody:
• Requests that don't turn into a service: deleted within 90 days, WhatsApp chats included.
  • Clients: for the duration of the relationship; allergies and diets for as long as they are needed or until you withdraw consent.
  • Tax documents: 10 years, as required by law.
privacy.cookiesBody: This website uses no profiling cookies and no analytics tools, and shows no advertising. It only stores, in your browser's memory, the language you choose: it is not sent to anyone and you can delete it from your browser settings.
privacy.rightsBody:
At any time you can ask us to access your data, correct it, erase it, restrict its processing, receive it in a readable format (portability) or object to the processing (Arts. 15-22 GDPR), and you can withdraw your consent. Write to the contact in section 1: we reply within one month.

We don't make decisions based solely on automated processing: the calculator gives an estimate, and Evelyn prepares the quote.
privacy.complaintBody: If you believe the processing does not comply with the GDPR, you can lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (www.garanteprivacy.it).
privacy.requiredTitle: 12. Do I have to give you my data?
privacy.requiredBody: Name, area and phone are needed to prepare your quote: without them we can't reply. Email and notes are optional. Information about allergies and diets is optional, but without it we can't adapt the menu.
privacy.changesBody: If this notice changes, we will publish the new version here with the updated date.
